program_model.instance_model: double-sided push-thru blade deployed at multiple entries; a larger 2-color variant also shown

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A double-sided internally lit projecting 'shoebox' blade sign with push-thru acrylic letterforms, mounted on welded arms through brick. A larger two-color version is also part of the set.
knowledge.rationale: A projecting blade is read along the sidewalk; push-thru acrylic on an internally lit shoebox gives crisp lit letters and robust through-brick mounting.

structure.construction: 2x4in (large variant 2x2in) aluminum tube frame, 1/8in aluminum shoebox faces with welded returns routed for push-thru, 3/4in clear acrylic push-thru letters with milled flange and 2nd-surface translucent white vinyl, 5000K LED
2x2in aluminum tube arms welded to 4x24x1/2in aluminum mounting plate, through brick

materials_manifest.product: Matthews satin black (large variant adds satin white)

craft_observations: Push-thru acrylic on a lit shoebox is a clean dimensional blade.
1/2in plate mount handles the projecting load through brick.
